translations.title: Music Night Under the Stars — a recap
translations.excerpt: On one weekend night in September, the slope of Phou Khao Khouay where Materm’s treehouses sit turned into an impromptu music stage. Three local bands took turns playing. A familiar place became a place to listen.
translations.label: Music Night
translations.hero_alt: Snow-capped mountains above a forest lake under heavy clouds

content.text: On one weekend night in September, the slope of Phou Khao Khouay where Materm’s treehouses sit turned into an impromptu music stage. Three local bands took turns playing. A familiar place became a place to listen.

Music Night belongs to the same story as the treehouses: a reason to come together, with the landscape still at the centre. This recap is a reflection on that meeting of music, community and place — and on what it means to make room for something shared, outdoors.

translations.gallery_description: What started as a small treehouse site in 2020 has grown into a place where campers, musicians, food lovers, and first-time visitors return to share the same slope of Phou Khao Khouay. Read the full story of how Materm came together.
